title: Abbas Nahi Aaye Abbas Nahi Aaye
body:
Abbas nahi aaye.... Abbas nahi aaye....
Zainab ne kaha rooker.... Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimoo me hai ek mehshar.... Abbas nahi aaye
1. Bache badi hasrat se takhte hai soowe maidaan
Zainab ke khareeb aaker karte hai basad na laa
Tadpati hai reh-reh ker yeh pyaas phuphi amma
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha rooker Abbas nahi aaye
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zehra ke bhare ghar ko ab koun bachayega
Naize ki aani par sar shabbir ka jayega
Aafaat se bay-woun ko ab koun chura-yega
Chein-jayegi ab chadar Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zainab ka tha yeh nouha ab dard ki dunya mein
Bhai mera tanha hai ab nargaye aada mein
Imdad ko koun aaye pardes mein sehra mein
Shabbir bache kyun ker Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Reh-reh key mere sar se girti hai meri chadar
Dekhi toh shah e wala kya hota hai dariya par
Abbas ki furqat mein mar-jaye na yeh khaher
Dum ghut ta hai reh reh ker Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kehti thi Sakina yeh darya pe mein jaa-oungi
Roo-the hai agar ammu mein unko mana-oungi
Roote hai haram saare main unko bata-oungi
Dil hilta hai yeh sunker Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Qasim ke be-chadne se dil sheh ka huwa zakhmi
Akber ki judai se jaati rahi benai-ee
Phirte hai kamar thame halat hai ajab sheh ki
Be-chain hai yeh keh kar Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Haa'n fatah e qaiber ka waha'n qatl huwa dilbar
Ya phirgaya sub paani bachou ki umeedou per
Sheh aaaye alam leker Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas nahi aaye Abbas nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz....manzer alia
